title: Add first firstmate work-handling explainer page, rendered from the stud
summary: Read as: build the first explainer page, a single static HTML page on how firstmate handles work, rendered by a Rust xtask command from the validated studies/firstmate-work-handling data, with a short design note. The Pages deploy workflow is left for a later change.

defaults_applied.how: The page is generated by Rust code in xtask, with no JS build chain.
Renderer tests cover output structure and escaping; cargo test and clippy must pass.
Each claim on the page links to its study claim id and pinned commit.
A short design note records the alternatives (hand-written HTML vs. generated) and the Pages-deploy deferral.
One page and one renderer; no deploy, no expert track.
The page and docs are written for an outside reader.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: No site exists yet (no site/ directory, no Pages workflow). The first page is a static HTML page generated in Rust, because all code is Rust.
Content comes from studies/firstmate-work-handling (claims, model, findings), not new research; every statement cites a claim id.
The page is mobile-friendly, supports light and dark modes, and uses a core track only; the expert track and the replay come later.
GitHub Pages deployment (a CI workflow) is out of scope because workflow files are governed.
The page covers only the claims in the study that passed validation.

acceptance_criteria.text: A renderer in xtask produces one self-contained HTML page explaining how firstmate handles work, with a viewport meta tag, responsive CSS, and a prefers-color-scheme dark mode.
Every factual statement on the page cites a claim id from studies/firstmate-work-handling/claims.json, and the page states the pinned firstmate commit from pin.json.
The page content is read from the study JSON files, not hard-coded; the page text is HTML-escaped.
A design note in docs/ records the alternatives considered and what is deferred (Pages deploy workflow, expert track, replay). CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
Run `cargo run -p xtask -- site` (or the named subcommand). It exits 0 and writes the HTML page. Check the output with `git status` and `ls`.
`cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets`, and `cargo fmt --check` all pass, including new renderer tests.
No governance files (CI workflows, athena.toml, Cargo lints) are modified.

out_of_scope: Expert track, replay view, and graphs
Site design tokens and feel spec
departures: Slightly higher cost and lower acceptance than the reference: the request is vague, no site scaffold exists, and the design doc says the Pages design should be written before building.
